title: Authoring, Search, Inspection and Presentation
objective: Implement species authoring/reference surfaces, builder projection, GM inspector, cross-links, assets and permission-aware presentation.
acceptance: UI is projection not rules authority
boundaries: MVPS-14 owns species-facing authoring/reference/search/inspection/presentation contracts and projections, not canonical rule execution.
Authoring surfaces compose governed intent and validation previews through owning persistence/authority paths rather than embedding direct canonical mutation or rule logic in UI.
Search and inspection expose stable identity, exact versions, provenance, validation/migration state and cross-links only after permission filtering.
Builder/GM presentation consumes MVPS-13 runtime projection and grant receipts read-only and cannot rewrite them or infer hidden canon.
Presentation assets, labels, layout and visualization remain mechanically separate from species rules and owner-domain mechanics.
NPC/creature reuse remains MVPS-15; radical-species golden proof remains MVPS-16; MVPS-15+ remain unauthorized until separately selected.
